description: Rum 60, lime 22.5, syrup 22.5 follows the Daiquiri (2 : 0.75 : 0.75). Its only variant is na-sour: the rum is replaced, lime and syrup carried over; acid and sweet are covered, so only the base slot stays open.
source: docs/templates.md#variants-by-alcohol-class and data/template-variants/*.json; the lines to replace and keep follow from the roles in tree.json (role base is replaced, every other line is carried over); open slots are the variant's slots whose role no carried line has, optional ones left out except the base; slot ratios and notes are the variant data's, assumptions

openSlots.note: tea, tisane or a non-alcoholic distillate in place of the spirit
